name: Garage Noord
description: Garage Noord is a small club with a restaurant on the Gedempt Hamerkanaal in Amsterdam-Noord, next to the Skatecafé. Daan Alvering and Rachella Groon opened it in 2017 in a former depot building. It has room for about 150 people. A second hall, bar40, is programmed by a different guest collective each time. The restaurant is open Thursday to Saturday for people who want to eat first and dance afterwards.
funFact: Resident Advisor reported the opening in August 2017: a 150-capacity club, with the music programmed by Daan Alvering (Al Dee).
identityNote: BAG pand 0363100012079768. Sources disagree on the building's former use (Amsterdam Now calls it a former car garage in its intro and a former GVB depot in its text), so the card says only 'a former depot building'.
